verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own docs name payroll/HR connectors (Gusto, Rippling) and CRM connectors (HubSpot, Salesforce) that let Ari plan from your records. They also say Ari keeps one model of the company current from ledger, bank and payroll, alongside accounting actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet. However, no evidence shows that headcount or pipeline fields are specifically mapped into that model next to the books, and nothing corroborates it independently. missing for 10: documentation of headcount data imported from payroll/HRIS, documentation of pipeline/opportunity data imported from the CRM and how it joins with ledger actuals in the model, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, payroll/HRIS and CRM connectors bring headcount and pipeline data into the same model as the books

citations.quote: Connect Gusto, Rippling, or another payroll or HR system, HubSpot or Salesforce, Stripe, or a database so Ari plans from your records.
Ari connects to your ledger, bank and payroll, keeps one model of the company current
Bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet.
